confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback pypdf extraction, targeted methods searches, rendered methods pages, and OUP/PMC supplement-route checks were reviewed. The main paper reports enough stimulus, timing, tactile, randomization, ITI, and count information for a passive iEEG trunk PPS recreation; exact original binaural sound files, gain/envelope calibration, and OUP supplementary tables remain unavailable.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The paper can be recreated as a passive trunk-centered front-approach white-noise profile with A, T, and AT conditions, three tactile distances/timings, jitter, ITI, and per-condition repetition count. It is not a behavioral RT task and relies on prerecorded binaural earphone stimuli rather than a live speaker trajectory.

source_checks.scope: Reviewed abstract, Material and Apparatus, Procedures, preprocessing/baseline, and discussion checks for task conditions and PPS distance logic.
Used as primary extraction map for pages 1-4 and methods/procedure paragraphs, then checked against fallback extraction and rendered page images.
Searched all 13 pages for stimulus, speaker, white noise, timing, jitter, ITI, baseline, catch, response, and trial-count terms.
Temporary rendered methods pages were visually checked to verify the apparatus/procedure paragraph and were not committed.
OUP page and supplement route were checked; supplement remained access-limited from this environment.

review_attempts.result: Identified the apparatus/procedure page with white-noise front approach, tactile timings, jitter, ITI, and 85-trial condition counts.
pypdf confirmed the same key Segment 1-4 fields and clarified that no overt behavioral task was requested.
Visually verified the dense methods page where apparatus, trajectory, timing, jitter, ITI, and counts are reported.
Separated the simulated front-approach binaural white-noise stimulus from the physical 2-array prerecording apparatus.
Mapped A, T, and AT randomized trials, tactile-only control/baseline logic, no behavioral catch task, 85 trials per condition, and derived total trials.
Supplementary material is referenced by the article, but OUP access was limited; missing exact sound files/gain curves therefore remain caveats.

stimulus_type.value: White-noise auditory stimulus simulating an approaching sound from the front.
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The auditory stimulus is identified as white noise approaching from the front.

source_provenance.value: Prerecorded using two 8-speaker arrays and a head-model binaural microphone; played back through insert earphones.
source_provenance.evidence_note: The paper reports physical recording provenance but not the original audio files.

trajectory_count.value: One front-centered approaching auditory trajectory used in unisensory A and multisensory AT trials.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: No receding or lateral trajectory is described.

trajectory_path.value: Simulated front approach centered on the body from 2 m maximum distance; tactile samples correspond to 1.7, 1.0, and 0.3 m.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Distance-at-touch values define the effective trajectory anchors.

stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Duration is directly reported for auditory trials.

stimulus_speed.evidence_note: Speed is reported with the 2 m approach trajectory.

auditory_conditions.value: Unisensory auditory A and multisensory audio-tactile AT conditions used the same approaching sound.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: The condition families are listed in the procedure.

gain_envelope.page_or_section: PDF p.3 methods; OUP supplement route checked 2026-06-16
gain_envelope.evidence_note: No SPL, gain law, or sound-file envelope parameters were found in accessible sources.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Etymotic ER-4P insert earphones; sounds prerecorded from two 8-speaker arrays with Omni binaural microphones; ExpyVR controlled delivery.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: The apparatus is reported in enough detail for a binaural-rendered approximation.

trial_rows_families.value: Three trial families: auditory-only A, tactile-only T, and audio-tactile AT.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The procedure enumerates the three trial types.

condition_intermixing.value: A, T, and AT trials were presented in randomized order.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Trial order was randomized; no separate condition blocks are reported.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: The paper says trials were presented in randomized manner.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Tactile timing jitter was 0-200 ms in 50 ms steps; ITI was randomly shuffled among 1.4, 1.7, and 1.9 s.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: Both within-trial tactile jitter and between-trial ITI values are reported.

response_window.value: No per-trial behavioral response window applies; patients had no overt task.
response_window.evidence_note: The procedure states that no overt task was requested.

task_sequence_rules.value: Patients lay reclined with eyes closed, attended to approaching sound/vibrations, and did not respond overtly.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: The passive attention rule is explicitly described.

tactile_stimulus.value: 100 ms vibrotactile stimulation on upper sternum using Precision MicroDrives 312-101 motor, 150 Hz, 3 V, 60 mA.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Tactile site, motor model, duration, and device parameters are reported.

soa_table.value: Tactile stimulation occurred at 500, 1500, and 2500 ms after trial/sound onset, plus 0-200 ms jitter.
soa_table.evidence_note: The same three timings are used for T and AT trials.

baseline_strategy.value: Unisensory tactile T trials served as the control/baseline for tactile responses and anticipation checks.
baseline_strategy.page_or_section: PDF pp.3-5, Procedures and Statistical Analysis
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: Analyses compare AT responses with tactile-only and EEG baseline responses.

baseline_timing.value: Tactile-only control timings were 500, 1500, and 2500 ms; EEG baseline correction used -100 to 0 ms prestimulus.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: Both task-control timing and neural baseline window are reported.

catch_trial_type.value: No behavioral catch/no-go trials are applicable; auditory-only trials are unisensory controls.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: There was no overt response task.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: 85 trials were presented for each A, T, and AT condition; T and AT trials each contained the three tactile timings.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: The per-condition trial count is explicit.

baseline_count.value: 85 tactile-only T trials were presented as the unisensory tactile control condition.
baseline_count.evidence_note: T is one of the three 85-trial conditions.

catch_count.value: No catch/no-go count applies; 85 auditory-only trials are unisensory A controls, not behavioral catches.
catch_count.evidence_note: The passive task has no response-withholding catch rule.

block_count.page_or_section: PDF p.3 methods; OUP supplement route checked 2026-06-16
block_count.evidence_note: Experiment duration is reported as about 20 minutes, but no block count was found.

total_trial_count.value: 255 trials total, derived from 85 trials x 3 conditions.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: Total is derived from the explicit per-condition count.

critical_caveats: Exact original binaural white-noise sound files are not provided.
No SPL, gain law, or envelope details were found in accessible sources.
External 2-array recording geometry is summarized but full physical setup details are delegated to Serino protocol papers.
OUP supplementary material was referenced but access-limited from this environment.
The study is a passive iEEG endpoint, not a behavioral RT task.
next_manual_action: Use this as a high-confidence passive trunk PPS protocol source for the Cell lineage audit; only exact audio assets/gain and block partitioning remain unresolved.
